This site is not just a web page: it is the **public interface of a scientific
database**. Behind it runs a simple, powerful system — *you maintain the information
once and everything else is generated automatically*.

We developed and applied this system at the Arboretum of Estancia La Constancia, and
it can be replicated for **other botanical collections**.

## What it solves

Many gardens, nurseries and reserves have their information scattered across
spreadsheets, folders and photos. This system unifies it into a single database and,
from it, automatically generates:

::: grid

::: {.g-col-4 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm .text-center}
### <i class="bi bi-map"></i> Interactive map
Location of each specimen, trails and sectors.
:::

::: {.g-col-4 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm .text-center}
### <i class="bi bi-tree"></i> Species profiles
One page per specimen, with no coding.
:::

::: {.g-col-4 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm .text-center}
### 📖 Catalogue with filters
Search by family, origin and group.
:::

::: {.g-col-4 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm .text-center}
### <i class="bi bi-bar-chart"></i> Statistics
Recalculated automatically with every update.
:::

::: {.g-col-4 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm .text-center}
### 🔗 QR labels
One code per tree that opens its profile.
:::

::: {.g-col-4 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm .text-center}
### 🔄 Automatic publishing
You update the database and the site rebuilds itself.
:::

:::

## Who it's for

Botanical gardens, arboreta, nurseries, municipalities, nature reserves, universities
and **estates** that want to document and showcase their natural heritage in a
professional way, sustainable over time.

## Why it works in the long run

- **Low maintenance:** a single spreadsheet feeds the whole site.
- **No daily technical dependency:** you don't need a programmer to load data.
- **Scalable:** it works the same for 50 or for 5,000 specimens.
- **Scientific and educational value:** the database supports research, conservation and outreach.
